summary: Joe Bevan has made history at Sandbach United, becoming the club's all-time leading scorer with 56 goals after a brace in their last match, surpassing James Kirby's previous record of 54. The Ramblers are looking to build on this momentum with back-to-back wins as they travel to Foley FC in their latest fixture. With an entire season still ahead, fans will be eager to see how many more goals Bevan can add to his impressive tally.
